title: 1st Marine Division breakout from Chosin Reservoir
caption: U.S. Marines and armor during the breakout from Chosin Reservoir, North Korea, December 1950.
original_caption: A column of troops and armor of the 1st Marine Division move through communist Chinese lines during their successful breakout from the Chosin Reservoir in North Korea.
creator: Cpl. Peter McDonald, USMC
credit: Cpl. Peter McDonald / U.S. Marine Corps
license: Public domain in the United States: official U.S. Marine Corps photograph taken as part of official duties
license_evidence: Wikimedia Commons file description identifies Cpl. Peter McDonald, USMC, and PD-USGov-Military-Marines status; original publication credited DefenseLINK.
caption_caution: Do not reproduce the legacy extended caption claiming China entered the war on27November; Chinese forces had entered before then. This photo depicts the Chosin breakout inDecember1950, not the western-front ChongchonRiver defeat.
